name: shell_command
description: Run one non-interactive shell command through an enabled bundled shell provider and return stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout state, and execution metadata.
promptDescription: Run one non-interactive shell command and wait for it to finish. Use this tool when you need to inspect the workspace, run tests, build the project, check command output, or perform a one-shot local command. Always provide [command]. Optional [provider] chooses one enabled provider: git-bash, powershell, or nushell. If omitted, the default provider is git-bash. Optional [workdir] sets the working directory; relative paths resolve from the e-b host working directory, and '.' means the current e-b host working directory. Optional [timeoutMs] sets the timeout and is clamped by config. Optional [maxOutputChars] controls captured output length and is clamped by config. Optional [description] should briefly explain why the command is being run. The tool returns structured stdout, stderr, combinedOutput, exitCode, timedOut, durationMs, provider, workdir, truncated, maxOutputChars, and error metadata. Do not use this tool for interactive terminal sessions, stdin prompts, long-running background jobs, PTY workflows, or commands that require follow-up input.

workdir.description: Working directory. Relative paths resolve from the e-b host working directory.

timeoutMs.description: Command timeout in milliseconds. Values above the configured maximum are clamped.

description.description: Short human-readable reason for running the command.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum captured characters per output field. Values above the configured maximum are clamped.

provider.description: Optional enabled provider id. Defaults to git-bash.
